days.why: an open bet whose start isn't known: around when it was placed, and yesterday and today
an open bet with its game's start: that day and the next, though it was two days ago
an open bet on a game tomorrow: its own day, before it starts
a settled bet with no start: the day it was placed and the next only
a one-game slip placed two days early: its game's start (game_start), not the day it was placed
a multi-game slip's first kickoff isn't every game's: an open game with none of its own looks around
